arStrings.szText: Don't worry about the preacher—he’s just another fool.
Lorath is considering everything he has seen. Something is troubling about what Lorath has heard from the preacher and the Akarat followers.
What troubles me is this talk of an eclipse. Mephisto’s planning a spectacle of some kind, and I’d wager it will be much darker than any of these people expect.
Lorath is considering everything he has seen. The preacher and followers spoke of an eclipse that would herald a bright new age to come. Lorath knows that it means something darker.
No use talking them out of going to Skovos though. They adore Akarat, and the scariest part is, it’s no spell.
Lorath is considering everything he has seen. Something is troubling about all these followers. They truly believe in Akarat, and that is scary to Lorath.
Mephisto won them over with real miracles. He’s playing the part of benevolent prophet, and playing it very damn well.
Lorath is considering everything he has seen. Something is troubling about all these followers. They truly believe in Akarat, and that is scary to Lorath.
Once we get to Skovos, we’ll need to act fast. Come on. Let’s get aboard.
